locator.title: Что стоит знать о привыкании к средствам от насморка
locator.lead: Откуда берется зависимость от средств для носа и когда может помочь Момат Рино
locator.caption: При медикаментозном рините может нарушиться механизм самоочищения носовой полости из-за повреждения реснитчатых клеток слизистой [1, 2]

current_heading.text: От каких[1]  средств может возникнуть зависимость

nearest_text_before.text: Если применять сосудосуживающие спреи или капли дольше, чем указано в инструкции, рецепторы слизистой оболочки носа могут перестать реагировать на них. Со временем способен развиться медикаментозный ринит — состояние, при котором слизистая утолщается и отек сохраняется постоянно из-за регулярного воздействия средства. В итоге, даже если нет контакта с аллергеном или простуды, чувство заложенности остается [1, 2].

nearest_text_after.text: Как помочь себе дышать легче без капель

image_reading: A tired young woman sits at a café table, holding a tissue beside a cup while her other hand rests against her cheek.
Her downcast gaze and slumped posture convey ongoing nasal-discomfort fatigue; the composition holds her face, tissue, and cup clearly in the foreground.
analysis.article_context: Body image following the explanation of rebound congestion and medication-induced rhinitis; it humanizes the persistent discomfort that can keep someone reaching for nasal remedies.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The animation supports the article's explanation of the persistent, draining discomfort associated with rebound nasal congestion.
structured_intent.primary_action: The woman slowly closes her fingers once around the tissue she is holding.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The tissue is visibly lightly crumpled and held still in her hand.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: Her weary sense of ongoing nasal-discomfort fatigue remains unchanged through the last frame.

models.scene_plan: Across five seconds, keep the camera fixed on the woman and the tissue. Her visible fingers gradually tighten around it once at an even, modest pace; the motion settles naturally near the end with the tissue softly crumpled in her hand. Her tired, congested expression remains unchanged.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera on the woman. Her fingers slowly close once around the tissue in a restrained, weary motion while she keeps her downcast expression. By the final frame, the tissue is gently crumpled and held still in her hand.

models.scene_plan: For this five-second shot, use a fixed camera and let the foreground hand progressively gather the tissue in one quiet, continuous squeeze. The action develops for most of the duration and eases to a stable endpoint close to the end. The woman remains visibly fatigued throughout.
models.positive_prompt: The woman slowly gathers the tissue in her hand once, maintaining her weary downcast expression; end with the lightly crumpled tissue held motionless in her hand. Fixed camera.

models.scene_plan: Within four seconds, hold a fixed composition and focus on one contained motion: the woman's fingers steadily draw the tissue into a light crumple. The squeeze resolves at the end of the shot, with the tissue still visible and held steady. Her weary discomfort remains present until the last frame.
